text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Epiphaneia-saaaan!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Make Debut had finally arrived.
The moment we reached Kyoto Racecourse, we were greeted by a massive crowd of reporters...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone came to see me!
Thank you!"
choice_data_list: (She's taking it like it's the most natural thing...)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'll go see you!
After all, you are *the*—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: After all, I'm the student of both Cesario-san and Kris S-san!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Cesario-san, who became a queen in two nations,
and Symboli Kris S-san, who won the Arima Kinen
by a staggering nine lengths—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"If they caught the eye of those two,
then their potential must be truly extraordinary...!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I'm super strong!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, such confidence...!"
"She truly has talent to spare..."
"She might just spearhead the new generation...!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario Fan
text_block_list.text:
Epi-chan, good luck~!
Just like Cesario-chan, I want to see a run
where anyone can tell at a glance how strong you are!

text_block_list.name: Kris S's Fan
text_block_list.text: Epiphaneia! I heard you've been learning from Kris S! We're expecting big things from you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I'm reminded of just how influential those two are.
Almost all the expectations gathering around Epiphaneia right now seem to stem from them.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone!
I'm so happy you're all expecting so much from me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'll carry the hopes of those two incredible runners, too!
And achieve a feat greater than both of them combined!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooohh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations
on your Make Debut!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
I wanted to make sure I saw it through with my own eyes, too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Epi—are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course!
Destiny is completely on my side, after all!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
With a magnificent run, I'll surpass everyone's expectations!
Yours included!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Cesario, Kris S!
Once again... thank you so much for everything!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The two of you were the ones
who awakened my power!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's why I was able to make it this far.
Together with you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you as well!
You're the one who polished my awakened power to perfection!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's why I will—
reach all the way to the ultimate victory!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"As everyone's ultimate masterpiece,
I'll carve my name into history!"
choice_data_list: ...All right, go out there and do your best, Epi!
...All right, go give it your all, Epi!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Let's carry everything everyone gave us and go!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And—
I shall become all of destiny!
